# Cypress CI Integrator Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > QA > Cypress

## Overview

Integrates Cypress tests with CI/CD pipelines including parallel execution, test recording, and failure analysis with Cypress Cloud

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [cypress-ci-integrator-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
cypress-ci-integrator-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@cypress-ci-integrator` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Configure Cypress in CI/CD environments
- Implement parallel test execution with Cloud
- Record test runs for debugging
- Configure automatic test balancing

## Technology Standards Applied

- **Cypress CI**: CI/CD configuration and optimization
- **Cypress Cloud**: Test recording and parallelization
- **Docker**: Cypress Docker images for CI
